description: Fix 4 integration issues from v3 review: document generation 422, coherence validation shape mismatch, VariableMatrix no persistence, Home page missing progress/description fields
steps: Make GenerateDocumentRequest.content optional and auto-derive from project phase_data when not provided
Fix CoherenceValidation component to map backend response (is_coherent/message) to UI display
Add backend endpoint for variable persistence and wire VariableMatrix component
Add description and progress fields to ResearchProject backend model and accept description in CreateProjectRequest
acceptance_criteria: generateDocument endpoint accepts requests without content field and auto-generates from project data
CoherenceValidation component renders correctly with backend response shape
VariableMatrix data persists via backend API
Home page renders progress bar and description from backend data
findings: All 65 backend tests pass. All 10 frontend tests pass. Frontend build succeeds cleanly. The document generation endpoint now accepts empty body (Optional[GenerateDocumentRequest] = None) and derives content from project phase data. The computed progress field uses @computed_field from pydantic so it serializes automatically in JSON responses.
